messages:
Maria (Partnerships): Heads up — Azure partner reported GPU runtime crashes after a kernel update; only failing on our marketplace image running megatron benchmark. Logs:
```
E Cuda error: cuLaunchKernel failed: UNKNOWN / kernel.cu:234
stacktrace: ...
``` 
Anyone seen this? @Tom @Cheng

Tom (Eng Runtime): Looking. Can you paste driver / CUDA / kernel versions + repro steps?

Maria (Partnerships): Driver: 520.61. CUDA: 12.1. Kernel: 6.2. Partner rolled out a kernel patch yesterday. ROCm nodes seem unaffected.

Sanjay (Partners): Vendor confirms they introduced an ABI change in that 6.2 patch. They're rolling it back but asked us to pin the driver in the marketplace image to 520.56 until upstream stabilizes.

Cheng (Eng-ML): We saw a smaller perf regression in prod earlier; suspect PTX vs SASS mismatch. Workaround might be to avoid certain fused kernels. Not great.

Allyson (Marketplace): Long-term we can't pin old drivers across the board. Proposal: create a compat-tagged image (e.g. redwood/rt:compat-520.56) and gate it via staged rollout / opt-in.

Jake (Eng-Infra): We can push a hotfix tag and add a compatibility flag to the image metadata. Will need Security signoff for using older driver binaries.

deploy-bot: CI job 4872 queued: compat-image-build (queued by Jake)

Maria (Partnerships): Action items:
1) Vendor revert ETA ~4h (Sanjay)
2) We publish compat image + docs (Jake / Allyson)
3) Prepare customer communication + rollback steps (Laura)
4) Eng to produce kernel/driver compatibility matrix and run targeted tests (Tom / Cheng)
Schedule: if revert confirmed, aim for staged marketplace push tomorrow afternoon and joint announcement next Tue.

Laura (Customer Success): On it — I'll draft the notice and include rollback + contact matrix. Need the compatibility table from Eng to include exact versions.

Tom (Eng Runtime): I'll run the compatibility matrix against our test fleet and attach results here. Also propose adding a megatron-ish CI job to pre-marketplace checks.

Sanjay (Partners): Also asking vendors for a short changelog of the ABI change so we can track long-term.

Maria (Partnerships): If vendor doesn't revert, we'll cut a hotfix driver build and coordinate QA with Marketplace. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
